boas_vindas.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]! This is [nome_empresa]. Glad to have you with us. Whenever you need a quote, a copy of a document or help with your insurance, just send us a message here.

cobranca.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]. A reminder from [nome_empresa]: your insurance installment of [valor] is due on [data]. If you have already paid, please disregard. If it is a bank slip, check that it is in the insurer's name. If you need a copy, tap the button below.

retomar.PARA: To talk again to someone who asked for a quote and went quiet.
retomar.TEXTO: Hi, [nome_cliente]! This is [nome_empresa]. Any questions left about your insurance quote? Just reply here and we will pick it up.
